meaning.growth: Is the economy speeding up or slowing down, as the market is pricing it right now. Positive favours cyclicals, industrials, energy and small caps; negative favours defensives, staples, healthcare and cash.
meaning.inflation: Whether the cost of things is rising or cooling. Positive favours real assets, commodities and pricing-power businesses and hurts long bonds; negative favours bonds and long-duration growth stocks.
meaning.policy: Whether money is getting cheaper or dearer: rate expectations, the 10-year yield and the dollar. Easing lifts almost everything, gold included; tightening is the headwind that turns a good growth reading into a bad year.

regime.note: Vote of live readings, display only, never fed into scoring. Every input is a trailing measurement, so a regime is identified late and can be revised.

breadth.guidance: Leadership narrowing into megacaps. Wave intact. Stay with leaders vs fighting it.
breadth.range_note: Broadening maturing. Keep what works, stop opening new breadth. Plan rotation to leaders.

notes.note: Friday. Traders square positions before the weekend, which tends to FADE the week's strongest move rather than extend it. That is not a reliable selloff: if the week was down, Friday often bounces. Direction follows the week, inverted.

Monthly expiry. Dealer hedging tends to PIN prices near large strikes into the close, suppressing movement, and that pin releases the following Monday. Expect a quiet Friday and a livelier Monday rather than a direction.
